command:
task_tmp_base=${TMPDIR:?TMPDIR is required}
redline_tmp=$(mktemp -d "$task_tmp_base/redline-invoke.XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -R -- "$redline_tmp"' EXIT
printf '%s\n' '--max=1 --output=response input.md' | TMPDIR="$redline_tmp" UV_NO_CACHE=1 UV_NO_PROJECT=1 uv run .agents/skills/redline/scripts/invoke.py

sed -n '1,260p' input.md
rg --files .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/genres | sort
sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/delivery.md
sed -n '1,220p' .agents/skills/redline/references/correction.md

task_tmp_base=${TMPDIR:?TMPDIR is required}
resolver_tmp=$(mktemp -d "$task_tmp_base/redline-language.XXXXXX")
TMPDIR="$resolver_tmp" UV_NO_CACHE=1 UV_NO_PROJECT=1 uv run --no-cache --no-project .agents/skills/kntnt/library/scripts/languages.py resolve --scope=composition --scope=review --scope=anti-slop en_GB
resolver_status=$?
rm -R -- "$resolver_tmp"
printf 'resolver_status=%s\n' "$resolver_status"

anatomy_tmp=$(mktemp -d "$task_tmp_base/redline-anatomy.XXXXXX")
TMPDIR="$anatomy_tmp" UV_NO_CACHE=1 UV_NO_PROJECT=1 uv run --no-cache --no-project .agents/skills/kntnt/library/scripts/article_anatomy.py - < input.md
anatomy_status=$?
rm -R -- "$anatomy_tmp"
printf 'anatomy_status=%s\n' "$anatomy_status"

sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/base.md
sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/base.review.md
sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/genres/article.md
sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/genres/article.review.md
sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/anti-slop.md
sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/web-craft.md
sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/web-craft.review.md
sed -n '1,260p' .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/article-anatomy.md
sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/article-anatomy.review.md
sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/headlines.md
sed -n '1,240p' .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/headlines.review.md

task_tmp_base=${TMPDIR:?TMPDIR is required}
anatomy_tmp=$(mktemp -d "$task_tmp_base/redline-rereview.XXXXXX")
TMPDIR="$anatomy_tmp" UV_NO_CACHE=1 UV_NO_PROJECT=1 uv run --no-cache --no-project .agents/skills/kntnt/library/scripts/article_anatomy.py - <<'ARTIFACT'
---
kntnt:
  genre: article
  technique: none
  language: en_GB
---

# Library opens from ten until two on Saturdays

The Saturday service will run as a limited trial.

By Alex Reed

For three months, the trial adds Saturday access to the library's existing weekday service. Weekday hours stay unchanged throughout the three months.

## Riverton will review the trial in January

Riverton staff will record Saturday visits during October, November and December. The council will use those counts at its January review to decide whether Saturday opening continues.

## Saturday visitors can use the usual entrance

Saturday opening runs from ten until two. Visitors enter through the same door as on weekdays, and can borrow and return books at the usual desk.
ARTIFACT
anatomy_status=$?
rm -R -- "$anatomy_tmp"
printf 'anatomy_status=%s\n' "$anatomy_status"

task_tmp_base=${TMPDIR:?TMPDIR is required}
proofread_uv_tmp=$(mktemp -d "$task_tmp_base/proofread-invoke.XXXXXX")
proofread_args='--language=en_GB --output=/Users/thomas/Projects/skills/.git/orchestrate-session-389-391-gpt/scratch/390/amend-1a1acf/paraphrased-headline/tmp/redline-proofread.BmnV2g/mechanical-output.md /Users/thomas/Projects/skills/.git/orchestrate-session-389-391-gpt/scratch/390/amend-1a1acf/paraphrased-headline/tmp/redline-proofread.BmnV2g/mechanical-input.md'
printf '%s\n' "$proofread_args" | TMPDIR="$proofread_uv_tmp" UV_NO_CACHE=1 UV_NO_PROJECT=1 uv run .agents/skills/proofread/scripts/invoke.py
proofread_status=$?
rm -R -- "$proofread_uv_tmp"
printf 'proofread_invoke_status=%s\n' "$proofread_status"

task_tmp_base=${TMPDIR:?TMPDIR is required}
mechanics_uv_tmp=$(mktemp -d "$task_tmp_base/proofread-language.XXXXXX")
TMPDIR="$mechanics_uv_tmp" UV_NO_CACHE=1 UV_NO_PROJECT=1 uv run --no-cache --no-project .agents/skills/kntnt/library/scripts/languages.py resolve --scope=mechanics en_GB
resolver_status=$?
rm -R -- "$mechanics_uv_tmp"
printf 'resolver_status=%s\n' "$resolver_status"
sed -n '1,320p' .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/mechanics.md

mechanical_dir=/Users/thomas/Projects/skills/.git/orchestrate-session-389-391-gpt/scratch/390/amend-1a1acf/paraphrased-headline/tmp/redline-proofread.BmnV2g
cmp -s "$mechanical_dir/mechanical-input.md" "$mechanical_dir/mechanical-output.md"
cmp_status=$?
printf 'mechanical_input_output_cmp=%s\n' "$cmp_status"
printf '%s\n' 'complete_mechanical_output:'
sed -n '1,260p' "$mechanical_dir/mechanical-output.md"
printf '%s\n' 'source_status_before_cleanup:'
git status --short -- input.md
rm -R -- "$mechanical_dir"
test ! -e "$mechanical_dir"
cleanup_status=$?
printf 'cleanup_status=%s\n' "$cleanup_status"
printf '%s\n' 'source_status_after_cleanup:'
git status --short -- input.md

pwd && printenv TMPDIR && for f in \
  .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/base.md \
  .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/base.review.md \
  .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/genres/article.md \
  .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/genres/article.review.md \
  .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/anti-slop.md \
  .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/web-craft.md \
  .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/web-craft.review.md \
  .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/article-anatomy.md \
  .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/article-anatomy.review.md \
  .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/headlines.md \
  .agents/skills/kntnt/library/references/editorial/headlines.review.md; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then
    wc -l "$f"
  else
    echo "MISSING $f"
  fi
done

task_tmp_base="${TMPDIR:?}"
task_run_tmp=$(mktemp -d "${task_tmp_base%/}/language-resolve.XXXXXX") || exit 1
trap 'find "$task_run_tmp" -depth -delete' EXIT
TMPDIR="$task_run_tmp" UV_NO_CACHE=1 UV_NO_PROJECT=1 uv run ".agents/skills/kntnt/library/scripts/languages.py" resolve --scope=composition --scope=review --scope=anti-slop "en_GB"

task_tmp_base="${TMPDIR:?}"
task_run_tmp=$(mktemp -d "${task_tmp_base%/}/article-anatomy.XXXXXX") || exit 1
trap 'find "$task_run_tmp" -depth -delete' EXIT
TMPDIR="$task_run_tmp" UV_NO_CACHE=1 UV_NO_PROJECT=1 uv run ".agents/skills/kntnt/library/scripts/article_anatomy.py" - <<'EOF'
---
kntnt:
  genre: article
  technique: none
  language: en_GB
---

The Saturday service will run as a limited trial.

By Alex Reed

For three months, the trial adds Saturday access to the library's existing weekday service. Weekday hours stay unchanged throughout the three months.

## Riverton will review the trial in January

Riverton staff will record Saturday visits during October, November and December. The council will use those counts at its January review to decide whether Saturday opening continues.

## Saturday visitors can use the usual entrance

Saturday opening runs from ten until two. Visitors enter through the same door as on weekdays, and can borrow and return books at the usual desk.
EOF
